subject: sty
title: (R)STY.------PHY.U.P.
description: Chart on book p. 416 (MID-W-10). STY (style) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information), C-CONT (composite continuance) and CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From MT-INFO: C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). From C-CONT: STF (source transfer). From CULT-AF-BS: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DYM: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and POL-DYM (political dynamics). From INDIV-TD: POST (postulation).
